First public **beta** of Faraón (Farár / Prší) for Windows: a test build. Settings, progress and statistics are saved locally on your PC.

## Downloads

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| **Faraon-0.1-beta-PC.exe** | Desktop version. A 16:9 window sized to your screen. You can resize it freely; **F11** or **Alt+Enter** switches to fullscreen. |
| **Faraon-0.1-beta-Phone.exe** | Phone version for testing the mobile layout on a PC. It opens a fixed **portrait** window shaped like a modern phone (19.5:9). The window can't be resized or turned to landscape, and the mouse works like a finger (no hover effects). |
| SHA256SUMS.txt | Checksums, if you want to verify the downloads. |

Both are single files: no install, no extra DLLs. Just download and double-click.

> **Windows SmartScreen:** the beta isn't code-signed, so Windows may show
> "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.

## What to test

- Local games against 1–3 bots (Easy / Medium / Hard), in the modes Classic, Olympic and Reverse Olympic.
- The **Faraón** and **Prší** rule presets, and the house rules under *Settings*.
- The tutorial (*How to play*), daily challenges, statistics, *Appearance* (card deck, table looks) and switching language (SK / CS / EN).
- In the Phone build: the whole game in portrait, and that everything fits and stays readable.

The version (`v0.1.0-beta`) is shown under the buttons in the main menu. Please mention it when you report a problem.

## Known limitations of this beta

- **Multiplayer** needs the game server, which isn't deployed yet. The Multiplayer screen will report the server as unavailable.
- **Ads and purchases are simulated.** The ad banner is a placeholder, and "Buy" in *Remove ads* uses a test store: no real payment, nothing is charged.
- Both builds share the same saved data in `%APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Faraón`. Delete that folder to start over as a new player (this also brings back the first-launch tutorial).
- Vibration does nothing on a PC.

---

**SK:** Prvá beta verzia pre Windows. *Faraon-0.1-beta-PC.exe* je počítačová verzia (okno 16:9, F11 = celá obrazovka). *Faraon-0.1-beta-Phone.exe* je telefónny formát: pevné okno na výšku, nedá sa zmeniť veľkosť ani otočiť. Ak Windows zobrazí „Windows ochránil váš počítač“, kliknite na **Ďalšie informácie → Spustiť aj tak**. Multiplayer zatiaľ nebeží a nákupy sú len simulované.
